uniteDbPokemon.notes: Batch-01 mechanics survey used descriptions, true_desc, notes, buffs, cooldowns, levels, and formulas from this public JSON.

passiveEffects.name: Pastel Veil
passiveEffects.originalDescription: The Pokémon's psychic counter charges based on the distance they run (up to 10 times). When the counter is full, the Pokémon is granted a shield, becoming hindrance resistant while the shield remains. When the Pokémon reaches an additional movement speed threshold, the damage dealt by moves is increased by 5/20/35/50/60%. The increased damage based on movement speed is calculated before dealing damage with moves.

uniteMoveEffects.name: Triad Blitz
uniteMoveEffects.originalDescription: The user becomes unstoppable and charges at the designated opposing Pokémon, shoving opposing Pokémon in the way and stunning them for 0.8s when hit. When the charge ends, a mysterious triangular space is created around the designated opposing Pokémon if the user hits them. That Pokémon cannot leave that space. When the mysterious space is created, this move can be used again up to 3 times within 5.5s. With each additional use, the user runs at high speed forward, damaging opposing Pokémon in their path. If the path of a dash starts or ends in the mysterious space, this move can be used again immediately afterward. Unite buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 20% Max HP Shield
